<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ro">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <meta name="description" content="Cultura tehnologiilor informaționale - importanță, reguli, riscuri, sfaturi de protecție și rol în game design">
    <meta name="theme-color" content="#1a1625">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <title>Cultura Tehnologiilor Informaționale</title>
    <style>
        /* ===== RESET & BASE ===== */
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        /* ===== THEME VARIABLES — DARK PINK/MAGENTA INFOGRAPHIC ===== */
        :root {
            /* Pink/Magenta accents (matching the infographic) */
            --pink-bright: #ff4d6d;
            --pink-mid: #f06292;
            --pink-deep: #e63959;
            --pink-soft: #ffb3c1;
            --pink-glow: rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.35);

            /* Dark navy/purple background */
            --navy-deepest: #0f0a1a;
            --navy-deep: #1a1625;
            --navy-mid: #2d2238;
            --navy-soft: #3a2d4a;
            --navy-light: #4a3f5c;

            /* Gradients */
            --gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy-deep) 0%, var(--navy-mid) 50%, var(--pink-deep) 100%);
            --gradient-hero: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--navy-deepest) 0%, var(--navy-deep) 40%, var(--navy-mid) 75%, var(--pink-deep) 100%);

            /* Semantic tokens — default theme is the dark infographic style */
            --accent: var(--pink-bright);
            --accent-dark: var(--pink-deep);
            --accent-soft: var(--pink-soft);
            --light: rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.08);
            --text: #e0dce8;
            --text-muted: #a89bb5;
            --heading: #ffffff;

            --bg: var(--navy-deep);
            --bg-glow: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 10%, rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.18) 0%, transparent 45%),
                       radial-gradient(circle at 85% 30%, rgba(230, 57, 89, 0.12) 0%, transparent 50%),
                       radial-gradient(circle at 50% 90%, rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.25) 0%, transparent 55%),
                       var(--navy-deep);
            --card-bg: rgba(45, 34, 56, 0.45);
            --card-bg-solid: #2a2235;
            --border: rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.18);
            --border-soft: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
            --panel-bg: rgba(15, 10, 26, 0.97);

            --rule-bg: rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.06);
            --rule-border: var(--pink-bright);
            --rule-title: var(--pink-soft);

            --risk-bg: rgba(74, 63, 92, 0.35);
            --risk-border: var(--pink-deep);
            --risk-title: var(--pink-soft);

            --warn-bg: rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.12);
            --warn-border: var(--pink-bright);

            --checklist-bg: rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.06);

            --creator-bg: rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.08);
            --creator-border: var(--pink-bright);
            --creator-title: var(--pink-soft);

            --shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
            --shadow-hover: rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.25);
            --pink-glow-shadow: 0 8px 32px var(--pink-glow);

            --footer-bg: var(--navy-deepest);
        }

        [data-theme="dark"] {
            /* Dark theme = even deeper, more saturated pink glow */
            --bg: var(--navy-deepest);
            --bg-glow: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 10%, rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.25) 0%, transparent 45%),
                       radial-gradient(circle at 85% 30%, rgba(230, 57, 89, 0.18) 0%, transparent 50%),
                       radial-gradient(circle at 50% 90%, rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.35) 0%, transparent 55%),
                       var(--navy-deepest);
            --card-bg: rgba(30, 22, 40, 0.7);
            --card-bg-solid: #1e1628;
            --text: #c9bdd8;
            --text-muted: #8a7da0;
            --heading: #ffe9ee;
            --light: rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.1);
            --border: rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.25);
            --border-soft: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            --panel-bg: rgba(8, 5, 16, 0.97);

            --rule-bg: rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.08);
            --rule-border: var(--pink-bright);
            --rule-title: #ff8fa3;

            --risk-bg: rgba(60, 50, 75, 0.5);
            --risk-border: var(--pink-deep);
            --risk-title: #ff8fa3;

            --warn-bg: rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.15);
            --warn-border: var(--pink-bright);

            --checklist-bg: rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.08);

            --creator-bg: rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.1);
            --creator-border: var(--pink-bright);
            --creator-title: #ff8fa3;

            --shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
            --shadow-hover: rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.35);

            --footer-bg: #050309;
        }

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Poppins', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
            line-height: 1.7;
            color: var(--text);
            background: var(--bg-glow);
            background-attachment: fixed;
            transition: background 0.3s, color 0.3s;
            position: relative;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        /* ===== PARTICLE / DOT PATTERN BACKGROUND (multi-layer parallax) ===== */
        .bg-particles {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .particle-layer {
            position: absolute;
            top: -30%;
            left: -15%;
            width: 130%;
            height: 160%;
            will-change: transform;
            transition: transform 0.05s linear;
        }

        .particle-layer.layer-slow    { animation: layer-drift-slow 60s linear infinite; }
        .particle-layer.layer-medium  { animation: layer-drift-med  45s linear infinite; }
        .particle-layer.layer-fast    { animation: layer-drift-fast 30s linear infinite; }

        @keyframes layer-drift-slow {
            0%   { transform: translate(0, 0); }
            50%  { transform: translate(15px, 12px); }
            100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
        }
        @keyframes layer-drift-med {
            0%   { transform: translate(0, 0); }
            50%  { transform: translate(-12px, 8px); }
            100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
        }
        @keyframes layer-drift-fast {
            0%   { transform: translate(0, 0); }
            50%  { transform: translate(8px, -10px); }
            100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
        }

        /* ===== Individual dot styles ===== */
        .dot {
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--pink-bright);
            opacity: 0.9;
        }

        /* Color variants */
        .dot.c-white  { background: #ffffff; }
        .dot.c-soft   { background: var(--pink-soft); }
        .dot.c-bright { background: var(--pink-bright); }
        .dot.c-deep   { background: var(--pink-deep); }
        .dot.c-mid    { background: var(--pink-mid); }

        /* Size variants */
        .dot.s-tiny   { width: 4px;   height: 4px;   }
        .dot.s-xxs    { width: 6px;   height: 6px;   }
        .dot.s-xs     { width: 9px;   height: 9px;   }
        .dot.s-sm     { width: 14px;  height: 14px;  }
        .dot.s-md     { width: 22px;  height: 22px;  }
        .dot.s-lg     { width: 36px;  height: 36px;  }
        .dot.s-xl     { width: 56px;  height: 56px;  }
        .dot.s-xxl    { width: 90px;  height: 90px;  }

        /* Glow / blur variants */
        .dot.glow-soft  { box-shadow: 0 0 6px currentColor, 0 0 12px currentColor; }
        .dot.glow-med   { box-shadow: 0 0 10px currentColor, 0 0 20px currentColor; }
        .dot.glow-strong {
            box-shadow: 0 0 14px currentColor, 0 0 28px currentColor, 0 0 42px currentColor;
        }
        .dot.blur-soft  { filter: blur(2px); }
        .dot.blur-med   { filter: blur(6px); }
        .dot.blur-strong { filter: blur(14px); }

        /* Big radial glows (giant blurred orbs) */
        .dot.orb {
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.75) 0%, rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.3) 40%, transparent 70%);
            filter: blur(20px);
        }
        .dot.orb-white {
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6) 0%, transparent 70%);
            filter: blur(15px);
        }
        .dot.orb-deep {
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(230, 57, 89, 0.7) 0%, transparent 70%);
            filter: blur(30px);
        }
        .dot.orb-size-1 { width: 150px; height: 150px; }
        .dot.orb-size-2 { width: 250px; height: 250px; }
        .dot.orb-size-3 { width: 400px; height: 400px; }
        .dot.orb-size-4 { width: 550px; height: 550px; }

        /* Hollow ring circles */
        .dot.ring {
            background: transparent;
            border: 2px solid currentColor;
            opacity: 0.7;
        }
        .dot.ring-2 {
            background: transparent;
            border: 3px solid currentColor;
            opacity: 0.6;
        }

        /* Animation variants for individual dots */
        @keyframes dot-float-1 {
            0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
            25%      { transform: translate(8px, -12px); }
            50%      { transform: translate(-6px, 8px); }
            75%      { transform: translate(10px, 4px); }
        }
        @keyframes dot-float-2 {
            0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
            33%      { transform: translate(-10px, -8px); }
            66%      { transform: translate(12px, 6px); }
        }
        @keyframes dot-pulse {
            0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.55; }
            50%      { transform: scale(1.4); opacity: 0.9; }
        }
        @keyframes dot-twinkle {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 0.3; transform: scale(1); }
            50%      { opacity: 1;   transform: scale(1.6); }
        }
        @keyframes dot-drift-diag {
            0%   { transform: translate(0, 0); }
            50%  { transform: translate(20px, -20px); }
            100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
        }
        @keyframes dot-orbit {
            0%   { transform: rotate(0deg) translateX(8px) rotate(0deg); }
            100% { transform: rotate(360deg) translateX(8px) rotate(-360deg); }
        }

        .dot.anim-float-1   { animation: dot-float-1 8s ease-in-out infinite; }
        .dot.anim-float-2   { animation: dot-float-2 12s ease-in-out infinite; }
        .dot.anim-pulse     { animation: dot-pulse 5s ease-in-out infinite; }
        .dot.anim-twinkle   { animation: dot-twinkle 3.5s ease-in-out infinite; }
        .dot.anim-drift     { animation: dot-drift-diag 10s ease-in-out infinite; }
        .dot.anim-twinkle-fast { animation: dot-twinkle 2s ease-in-out infinite; }

        /* Hide on reduced-motion preference */
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            .particle-layer,
            .dot {
                animation: none !important;
                transition: none !important;
            }
        }

        body > * {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        /* ===== PANOU LATERAL DREAPTA (hover) ===== */
        .side-panel {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 100vh;
            width: 250px;
            z-index: 1000;
            transform: translateX(250px);
            transition: transform 0.4s ease;
        }

        .side-panel:hover,
        .side-panel:focus-within {
            transform: translateX(0);
        }

        .panel-handle {
            position: absolute;
            left: -36px;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            width: 36px;
            padding: 1.2rem 0;
            background: var(--panel-bg);
            color: var(--pink-soft);
            border-radius: 10px 0 0 10px;
            border-left: 2px solid var(--pink-bright);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            cursor: pointer;
            box-shadow: -2px 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
        }

        .panel-handle .arrow {
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            transition: transform 0.4s;
        }

        .side-panel:hover .arrow,
        .side-panel:focus-within .arrow {
            transform: rotate(180deg);
        }

        .panel-content {
            height: 100%;
            background: var(--panel-bg);
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            box-shadow: -8px 0 32px rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.2);
            padding: 4.5rem 1.5rem 1.5rem;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 2rem;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }

        .panel-content ul {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.3rem;
        }

        .panel-content a {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            color: var(--text);
            text-decoration: none;
            padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
            border-radius: 8px;
            transition: background 0.3s, padding-left 0.3s, color 0.3s;
            border-left: 3px solid transparent;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .panel-content a:hover,
        .panel-content a:focus-visible {
            background: var(--pink-bright);
            border-left-color: var(--pink-soft);
            padding-left: 1.3rem;
        }

        .nav-icon {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            width: 1.6rem;
            height: 1.6rem;
            margin-right: 0.6rem;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            color: var(--pink-soft);
            background: rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.12);
            border-radius: 6px;
            transition: color 0.3s, background 0.3s;
        }

        .nav-icon svg {
            width: 1rem;
            height: 1rem;
            stroke: currentColor;
            fill: none;
            stroke-width: 2;
            stroke-linecap: round;
            stroke-linejoin: round;
        }

        .panel-content a:hover .nav-icon,
        .panel-content a:focus-visible .nav-icon {
            color: white;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
        }

        .panel-controls {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.8rem;
            padding-top: 1.5rem;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.25);
        }

        .panel-controls .label {
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .lang-switcher {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.3rem;
        }

        .lang-switcher button,
        .theme-toggle {
            background: transparent;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
            color: white;
            padding: 0.4rem 0.7rem;
            border-radius: 6px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .lang-switcher button:hover,
        .theme-toggle:hover {
            background: var(--pink-bright);
            border-color: var(--pink-soft);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.35);
        }

        .lang-switcher button.active {
            background: var(--pink-bright);
            border-color: var(--pink-soft);
            box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.45);
        }

        .theme-toggle {
            width: 100%;
        }

        /* ===== HERO ===== */
        header {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(15, 10, 26, 0.92) 0%, rgba(26, 22, 37, 0.85) 40%, rgba(45, 34, 56, 0.7) 75%, rgba(230, 57, 89, 0.6) 100%);
            color: white;
            text-align: center;
            padding: 6rem 2rem 6rem;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.25);
            backdrop-filter: blur(2px);
        }

        header::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            top: -50%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            width: 800px;
            height: 800px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.5) 0%, transparent 65%);
            filter: blur(50px);
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        header::after {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--pink-bright), transparent);
            opacity: 0.4;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        header h1, header p {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        header h1 {
            font-size: 3.4rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
            color: #ffffff;
            text-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.5), 0 0 60px rgba(230, 57, 89, 0.3);
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        header p {
            font-size: 1.25rem;
            font-weight: 300;
            max-width: 700px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            opacity: 0.92;
            color: #ffe9ee;
        }

        /* ===== SECTIONS ===== */
        section {
            max-width: 900px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 4rem 2rem;
        }

        section h2 {
            color: var(--heading);
            font-size: 2.1rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            border-left: 5px solid var(--accent);
            padding-left: 1.2rem;
            letter-spacing: -0.01em;
            box-shadow: -5px 0 20px -10px var(--pink-bright);
        }

        section p {
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
            font-size: 1.05rem;
        }

        .card {
            background: var(--card-bg);
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-soft);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 2.5rem;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 32px var(--shadow);
            margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
            transition: background 0.3s, border-color 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s;
        }

        .card:hover {
            border-color: var(--border);
            box-shadow: 0 12px 40px var(--shadow), 0 0 24px rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.15);
        }

        /* ===== LISTS ===== */
        ul.styled {
            list-style: none;
            margin: 1.5rem 0;
        }

        ul.styled li {
            padding: 0.8rem 1rem 0.8rem 2.5rem;
            position: relative;
            background: var(--light);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-soft);
            border-radius: 8px;
            margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
            transition: background 0.3s, border-color 0.3s, transform 0.3s;
        }

        ul.styled li:hover {
            border-color: var(--border);
            transform: translateX(4px);
            box-shadow: -4px 0 16px -8px var(--pink-bright);
        }

        ul.styled li::before {
            content: "✔";
            position: absolute;
            left: 0.9rem;
            color: var(--accent);
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        /* ===== GAME DESIGN GRID ===== */
        .grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
            gap: 1.5rem;
            margin-top: 1.5rem;
        }

        .grid-item {
            background: var(--light);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-soft);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 1.5rem;
            transition: transform 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s, border-color 0.3s;
        }

        .grid-item:hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px);
            box-shadow: 0 12px 28px var(--shadow-hover), 0 0 24px rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.2);
            border-color: var(--border);
        }

        .grid-item h3 {
            color: var(--accent);
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        /* ===== REGULI & RISCURI ===== */
        .rule-box {
            border-left: 4px solid var(--rule-border);
            background: var(--rule-bg);
            border-radius: 0 12px 12px 0;
            padding: 1.2rem 1.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
            transition: background 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s;
        }

        .rule-box:hover {
            box-shadow: -4px 0 16px -6px var(--pink-bright);
        }

        .rule-box h3 {
            color: var(--rule-title);
            margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .risk-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr));
            gap: 1.5rem;
            margin-top: 1.5rem;
        }

        .risk-item {
            background: var(--risk-bg);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 1.5rem;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-soft);
            border-top: 4px solid var(--risk-border);
            transition: transform 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s, border-color 0.3s;
        }

        .risk-item:hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px);
            box-shadow: 0 12px 28px var(--shadow-hover), 0 0 24px rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.2);
        }

        .risk-item h3 {
            color: var(--risk-title);
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .warn-banner {
            background: var(--warn-bg);
            border-left: 5px solid var(--warn-border);
            padding: 1.2rem 1.5rem;
            border-radius: 0 10px 10px 0;
            margin-top: 2rem;
        }

        /* ===== SFATURI PENTRU INCEPATORI ===== */
        .tip-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr));
            gap: 1.5rem;
            margin-top: 1.5rem;
        }

        .tip-card {
            background: var(--card-bg);
            backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-soft);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 1.5rem;
            transition: transform 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s, border-color 0.3s;
        }

        .tip-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px);
            box-shadow: 0 12px 28px var(--shadow-hover), 0 0 24px rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.2);
            border-color: var(--border);
        }

        .tip-card h3 {
            color: var(--accent);
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .tip-card p {
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            margin-bottom: 0;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .security-checklist {
            background: var(--checklist-bg);
            border-left: 5px solid var(--accent);
            border-radius: 0 12px 12px 0;
            padding: 1.5rem 2rem;
            margin-top: 2.5rem;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-soft);
            border-left: 5px solid var(--accent);
        }

        .security-checklist h3 {
            color: var(--accent);
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .security-checklist ul {
            list-style: none;
        }

        .security-checklist li {
            padding: 0.4rem 0 0.4rem 2rem;
            position: relative;
        }

        .security-checklist li::before {
            content: "☑";
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            color: var(--accent-dark);
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        .creator-tip {
            background: var(--creator-bg);
            border-left: 5px solid var(--creator-border);
            border-radius: 0 12px 12px 0;
            padding: 1.5rem 2rem;
            margin-top: 1.5rem;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-soft);
            border-left: 5px solid var(--creator-border);
        }

        .creator-tip h3 {
            color: var(--creator-title);
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        /* ===== CONCLUSION ===== */
        .conclusion {
            background: var(--gradient);
            color: white;
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 3rem;
            text-align: center;
            box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.3);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.3);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .conclusion::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            top: -50%;
            left: -10%;
            width: 60%;
            height: 200%;
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.4) 0%, transparent 60%);
            filter: blur(30px);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .conclusion h2 {
            color: white;
            border: none;
            padding: 0;
        }

        /* ===== POP QUIZ ===== */
        .quiz {
            background: var(--card-bg);
            backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 2.5rem;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 40px var(--shadow);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .quiz::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            top: -30%;
            right: -10%;
            width: 50%;
            height: 160%;
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse, var(--pink-glow) 0%, transparent 60%);
            filter: blur(40px);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .quiz__header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 1rem;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .quiz__title-wrap {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.85rem;
        }

        .quiz__badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            width: 48px;
            height: 48px;
            border-radius: 14px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--pink-bright), var(--pink-deep));
            box-shadow: 0 6px 20px var(--pink-glow);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .quiz__badge svg {
            width: 26px;
            height: 26px;
            stroke: white;
            stroke-width: 2.2;
            fill: none;
            stroke-linecap: round;
            stroke-linejoin: round;
        }

        .quiz__title {
            color: var(--heading);
            font-size: 1.75rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            border: none;
            padding: 0;
            margin: 0;
        }

        .quiz__subtitle {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            margin-top: 0.25rem;
        }

        .quiz__score {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            padding: 0.55rem 1.1rem;
            border-radius: 999px;
            background: var(--light);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--accent-soft);
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 0.92rem;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .quiz__score-num {
            color: var(--accent);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        .quiz__progress {
            height: 6px;
            width: 100%;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            border-radius: 999px;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .quiz__progress-bar {
            height: 100%;
            width: 0%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--pink-bright), var(--pink-soft));
            border-radius: 999px;
            transition: width 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1);
            box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--pink-glow);
        }

        .quiz__card {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            animation: quizFadeIn 0.45s ease both;
        }

        @keyframes quizFadeIn {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); }
            to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }

        .quiz__q-meta {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 1rem;
            margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
        }

        .quiz__q-index {
            font-size: 0.82rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            color: var(--accent-soft);
        }

        .quiz__q-text {
            color: var(--heading);
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            line-height: 1.45;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }

        .quiz__options {
            list-style: none;
            display: grid;
            gap: 0.85rem;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
        }

        .quiz__option {
            position: relative;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 1rem;
            padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035);
            border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);
            border-radius: 14px;
            color: var(--text);
            font-size: 1rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            line-height: 1.4;
            cursor: pointer;
            user-select: none;
            transition: transform 0.18s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
            text-align: left;
            width: 100%;
            font-family: inherit;
        }

        .quiz__option:hover:not(:disabled) {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            border-color: var(--pink-bright);
            background: rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.08);
            box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.15);
        }

        .quiz__option:focus-visible {
            outline: 3px solid var(--pink-soft);
            outline-offset: 2px;
        }

        .quiz__option:disabled {
            cursor: default;
        }

        .quiz__marker {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            width: 36px;
            height: 36px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
        }

        .quiz__option:hover:not(:disabled) .quiz__marker {
            background: var(--pink-bright);
            color: white;
        }

        .quiz__option-text {
            flex: 1;
        }

        /* States after answering */
        .quiz__option--correct {
            background: rgba(46, 204, 113, 0.14);
            border-color: #2ecc71;
            color: #d8ffe8;
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #2ecc71 inset, 0 6px 20px rgba(46, 204, 113, 0.25);
            animation: quizPulseCorrect 0.5s ease;
        }

        @keyframes quizPulseCorrect {
            0%   { transform: scale(1); }
            35%  { transform: scale(1.025); }
            100% { transform: scale(1); }
        }

        .quiz__option--correct .quiz__marker {
            background: #2ecc71;
            color: white;
        }

        .quiz__option--correct .quiz__marker svg {
            width: 20px;
            height: 20px;
            stroke: white;
            stroke-width: 3;
            fill: none;
            stroke-linecap: round;
            stroke-linejoin: round;
        }

        .quiz__option--wrong {
            background: rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.14);
            border-color: var(--pink-bright);
            color: #ffd8e0;
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--pink-bright) inset, 0 6px 20px var(--pink-glow);
            animation: quizShakeWrong 0.4s ease;
        }

        @keyframes quizShakeWrong {
            0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); }
            20%      { transform: translateX(-6px); }
            40%      { transform: translateX(6px); }
            60%      { transform: translateX(-4px); }
            80%      { transform: translateX(4px); }
        }

        .quiz__option--wrong .quiz__marker {
            background: var(--pink-bright);
            color: white;
        }

        .quiz__option--wrong .quiz__marker svg {
            width: 18px;
            height: 18px;
            stroke: white;
            stroke-width: 3;
            fill: none;
            stroke-linecap: round;
            stroke-linejoin: round;
        }

        .quiz__option--muted {
            opacity: 0.45;
        }

        .quiz__feedback {
            margin-top: 1.25rem;
            padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-size: 0.97rem;
            line-height: 1.5;
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: 0.75rem;
            animation: quizFadeIn 0.3s ease both;
        }

        .quiz__feedback--correct {
            background: rgba(46, 204, 113, 0.1);
            border: 1px solid rgba(46, 204, 113, 0.4);
            color: #c5f5d6;
        }

        .quiz__feedback--wrong {
            background: var(--warn-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--warn-border);
            color: var(--accent-soft);
        }

        .quiz__feedback-icon {
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: 22px;
            height: 22px;
            margin-top: 1px;
        }

        .quiz__feedback-text strong {
            color: inherit;
        }

        .quiz__actions {
            margin-top: 1.5rem;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 1rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .quiz__btn {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.55rem;
            padding: 0.85rem 1.6rem;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-family: inherit;
            font-size: 1rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: transform 0.18s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease;
        }

        .quiz__btn:disabled {
            opacity: 0.4;
            cursor: not-allowed;
        }

        .quiz__btn--primary {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--pink-bright), var(--pink-deep));
            color: white;
            box-shadow: 0 6px 20px var(--pink-glow);
        }

        .quiz__btn--primary:not(:disabled):hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 10px 28px var(--pink-glow);
        }

        .quiz__btn--ghost {
            background: transparent;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-soft);
        }

        .quiz__btn--ghost:hover {
            color: var(--accent-soft);
            border-color: var(--accent);
        }

        .quiz__btn svg {
            width: 18px;
            height: 18px;
            stroke: currentColor;
            stroke-width: 2.2;
            fill: none;
            stroke-linecap: round;
            stroke-linejoin: round;
        }

        .quiz__results {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 1rem 0.5rem 0;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            animation: quizFadeIn 0.5s ease both;
        }

        .quiz__results-score {
            font-size: 3.2rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--accent);
            text-shadow: 0 0 28px var(--pink-glow);
            line-height: 1;
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        .quiz__results-score small {
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .quiz__results-title {
            color: var(--heading);
            font-size: 1.4rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
        }

        .quiz__results-msg {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 1rem;
            max-width: 480px;
            margin: 0 auto 1.5rem;
            line-height: 1.55;
        }

        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            .quiz { padding: 1.75rem 1.25rem; }
            .quiz__title { font-size: 1.35rem; }
            .quiz__q-text { font-size: 1.05rem; }
            .quiz__option { padding: 0.85rem 1rem; font-size: 0.95rem; }
            .quiz__marker { width: 30px; height: 30px; font-size: 0.85rem; }
            .quiz__results-score { font-size: 2.6rem; }
            .quiz__results-score small { font-size: 1.25rem; }
        }

        /* ===== FOOTER ===== */
        footer {
            background: var(--footer-bg);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-align: center;
            padding: 2rem 1.5rem;
            margin-top: 2rem;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border-soft);
        }

        footer a {
            color: var(--pink-soft);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-weight: 500;
            transition: color 0.3s;
        }

        footer a:hover {
            color: var(--pink-bright);
            text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.5);
        }

        /* ===== TEXT EMPHASIS GLOW ===== */
        strong, b {
            color: var(--accent-soft);
            font-weight: 600;
            text-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.25);
        }

        em, i {
            color: var(--pink-mid);
            font-style: italic;
        }

        a {
            color: var(--accent);
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: color 0.3s, text-shadow 0.3s;
        }

        a:hover {
            color: var(--pink-soft);
            text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.4);
        }

        section p {
            color: var(--text);
        }

        /* ===== SECTION DIVIDER GLOW ===== */
        section {
            position: relative;
        }

        section::after {
            content: "";
            display: block;
            width: 60px;
            height: 3px;
            margin: 2rem auto 0;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--pink-bright), transparent);
            opacity: 0.4;
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        /* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            header h1 { font-size: 2.2rem; }
            header p { font-size: 1rem; }
            header { padding: 4rem 1rem 3rem; }
            section { padding: 3rem 1rem; }
            .side-panel { width: 220px; transform: translateX(220px); }
            .conclusion { padding: 2rem 1.5rem; }
            .card { padding: 1.5rem; }
        }

        /* ===== CUSTOM SCROLLBAR ===== */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 10px;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: var(--navy-deep);
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--pink-bright), var(--pink-deep));
            border-radius: 5px;
            border: 2px solid var(--navy-deep);
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--pink-soft), var(--pink-bright));
        }

        /* ===== ACCESIBILITATE ===== */
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
            * { transition: none !important; }
        }

        /* ===== SCROLL REVEAL ANIMATIONS ===== */
        /* Inspirat din Apple, Stripe, Linear — animații subtile la intrarea în viewport */
        :root {
            --reveal-distance: 32px;
            --reveal-duration: 0.75s;
            --reveal-easing: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
        }

        [data-reveal] {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(var(--reveal-distance));
            transition:
                opacity var(--reveal-duration) var(--reveal-easing),
                transform var(--reveal-duration) var(--reveal-easing);
            transition-delay: var(--reveal-delay, 0ms);
            will-change: opacity, transform;
        }

        [data-reveal="fade-down"]  { transform: translateY(calc(-1 * var(--reveal-distance))); }
        [data-reveal="fade-left"]  { transform: translateX(calc(-1 * var(--reveal-distance))); }
        [data-reveal="fade-right"] { transform: translateX(var(--reveal-distance)); }
        [data-reveal="scale"]      { transform: scale(0.94); }
        [data-reveal="blur"] {
            filter: blur(10px);
            transition:
                opacity var(--reveal-duration) var(--reveal-easing),
                filter var(--reveal-duration) var(--reveal-easing),
                transform var(--reveal-duration) var(--reveal-easing);
        }

        [data-reveal].is-visible {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: none;
            filter: none;
        }

        /* Word-by-word reveal pentru titlul hero (efect Apple keynote) */
        [data-word-reveal] .word {
            display: inline-block;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(0.5em);
            transition:
                opacity 0.55s var(--reveal-easing),
                transform 0.55s var(--reveal-easing);
            will-change: opacity, transform;
        }

        [data-word-reveal].is-visible .word {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: none;
        }

        /* Glow puls pentru badge-urile animate (header) */
        @keyframes revealGlowPulse {
            0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 6px 20px var(--pink-glow); }
            50%      { box-shadow: 0 6px 32px rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.55); }
        }

        /* Accesibilitate: dezactivăm animațiile de reveal când utilizatorul preferă motion redus */
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            [data-reveal] {
                opacity: 1 !important;
                transform: none !important;
                filter: none !important;
                transition: none !important;
            }
            [data-word-reveal] .word {
                opacity: 1 !important;
                transform: none !important;
                transition: none !important;
            }
        }

        /* ===== CORNER SMILEY (hover-to-open) ===== */
        .corner-smiley {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 22px;
            right: 22px;
            width: 72px;
            height: 72px;
            z-index: 9999;
            display: block;
            cursor: pointer;
            filter: drop-shadow(0 6px 18px rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.35))
                    drop-shadow(0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45));
            animation: smiley-float 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;
            transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1),
                        filter 0.25s ease;
            -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
        }

        .corner-smiley .smiley-img {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: contain;
            pointer-events: none;
            user-select: none;
            -webkit-user-drag: none;
            transition: opacity 0.18s ease;
        }

        .corner-smiley .smiley-open {
            opacity: 0;
        }

        .corner-smiley:hover,
        .corner-smiley:focus-visible {
            transform: scale(1.12) rotate(-4deg);
            filter: drop-shadow(0 10px 26px rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.55))
                    drop-shadow(0 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55));
        }

        .corner-smiley:hover .smiley-closed,
        .corner-smiley:focus-visible .smiley-closed {
            opacity: 0;
        }

        .corner-smiley:hover .smiley-open,
        .corner-smiley:focus-visible .smiley-open {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        .corner-smiley:active {
            transform: scale(1.04) rotate(-2deg);
        }

        @keyframes smiley-float {
            0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg); }
            50%      { transform: translateY(-8px) rotate(2deg); }
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            .corner-smiley {
                animation: none;
                transition: none;
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 640px) {
            .corner-smiley {
                width: 56px;
                height: 56px;
                bottom: 16px;
                right: 16px;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <!-- ===== COLȚ: FAȚA ZÂMBITOARE (se schimbă la hover în varianta cu gura deschisă) ===== -->
    <a href="#top" class="corner-smiley"
       aria-label="Înapoi sus"
       title="Înapoi sus 😊">
        <img src="data:image/png;base64,"
             alt=""
             class="smiley-img smiley-closed"
             width="72" height="72" decoding="async" loading="lazy">
        <img src="data:image/png;base64,"
             alt=""
             class="smiley-img smiley-open"
             width="72" height="72" decoding="async" loading="lazy">
    </a>

    <div class="bg-particles" aria-hidden="true">
        <div class="particle-layer layer-slow">
            <span class="dot orb orb-size-4 orb" style="left: 4.4%; top: 14.0%;"></span>
            <span class="dot orb orb-size-3 orb-deep" style="left: 15.6%; top: 2.7%;"></span>
            <span class="dot orb orb-size-2 orb-white" style="left: 86.6%; top: 2.6%;"></span>
            <span class="dot orb orb-size-3 orb" style="left: 80.1%; top: 88.6%;"></span>
            <span class="dot orb orb-size-2 orb-deep" style="left: 69.8%; top: 87.4%;"></span>
            <span class="dot orb-size-4 orb orb" style="left: 4.4%; top: 83.7%;"></span>
            <span class="dot orb-size-4 orb orb" style="left: 15.9%; top: 93.6%;"></span>
            <span class="dot s-lg ring-2 c-soft anim-pulse" style="left: 96.4%; top: 38.1%;animation-delay: -0.18329753462264886s;"></span>
            <span class="dot s-xl ring-2 c-white " style="left: 24.7%; top: 94.7%;animation-delay: -2.5427377770576007s;"></span>
            <span class="dot s-xl ring c-soft anim-twinkle" style="left: 10.2%; top: 90.4%;animation-delay: -1.849040847404463s;"></span>
            <span class="dot s-xl ring c-bright anim-float-2" style="left: 90.7%; top: 21.4%;animation-delay: -1.6046591480893158s;"></span>
            <span class="dot s-md ring c-white anim-twinkle" style="left: 6.9%; top: 86.5%;animation-delay: -0.9865100307759338s;"></span>
            <span class="dot s-xxl ring c-mid anim-pulse" style="left: 97.0%; top: 39.9%;animation-delay: -3.023128630134951s;"></span>
            <span class="dot s-xxs c-mid  anim-float-2" style="left: 79.2%; top: 88.8%;animation-delay: -1.2570705999090659s;"></span>
            <span class="dot s-lg ring-2 c-white " style="left: 67.7%; top: 12.2%;animation-delay: -0.01622658050864645s;"></span>
            <span class="dot s-sm c-soft  anim-float-2" style="left: 96.2%; top: 75.7%;animation-delay: -3.0448510571908614s;"></span>
            <span class="dot s-sm c-soft  anim-twinkle" style="left: 87.4%; top: 19.9%;animation-delay: -0.5593386266044753s;"></span>
            <span class="dot s-sm c-deep glow-soft " style="left: 7.5%; top: 80.5%;animation-delay: -2.6635308476475785s;"></span>

                s3_k5t: "Răspundere legală",
                s3_k5p: "Încălcarea drepturilor de autor, distribuirea ilegală de conținut sau infracțiunile informatice pot duce la amenzi și chiar la răspundere penală.",
                s3_k6t: "Excludere digitală",
                s3_k6p: "Absența competențelor digitale de bază limitează accesul la educație, locuri de muncă și servicii publice modernizate.",
                s3_warn: "<strong>Concluzie parțială:</strong> Cunoașterea și respectarea regulilor culturii tehnologiilor informaționale este prima linie de apărare împotriva majorității pericolelor din mediul digital. Educația digitală nu este opțională — este o formă de auto-protecție.",
                s4_title: "Sfaturi pentru utilizatorii noi de internet",
                s4_intro: "Dacă abia începi să navighezi pe internet sau îți dorești să creezi conținut online, aceste sfaturi te vor ajuta să te protejezi pe tine și pe cei dragi:",
                s4_t1t: "Folosește parole puternice",
                s4_t1p: "Creează parole de minim 12 caractere, cu litere mari și mici, cifre și simboluri. Nu folosi aceeași parolă pentru mai multe conturi.",
                s4_t2t: "Activează autentificarea în doi pași",
                s4_t2p: "Autentificarea în doi pași (2FA) adaugă un nivel suplimentar de securitate — chiar dacă parola este furată, contul rămâne protejat.",
                s4_t3t: "Fii atent la phishing",
                s4_t3p: "Nu da click pe link-uri din e-mailuri sau mesaje suspecte. Verifică întotdeauna adresa reală a site-ului înainte de a introduce date.",
                s4_t4t: "Evită rețelele Wi-Fi publice",
                s4_t4p: "Nu introduce parole sau date bancare în rețele Wi-Fi publice (cafenele, aeroporturi) — ele pot fi interceptate cu ușurință.",
                s4_t5t: "Fă copii de rezervă",
                s4_t5p: "Salvează periodic fișierele importante pe un stick USB, hard disk extern sau în cloud. Regula 3-2-1: 3 copii, pe 2 medii, 1 în afara casei.",
                s4_t6t: "Actualizează-ți dispozitivele",
                s4_t6p: "Actualizările de sistem și de browser corectează vulnerabilități de securitate. Nu le amâna!",
                s4_t7t: "Gândește înainte de a posta",
                s4_t7p: "Orice publici pe internet rămâne acolo pentru totdeauna. Nu posta informații care te pot compromite mai târziu.",
                s4_t8t: "Verifică setările de confidențialitate",
                s4_t8p: "Revizuiește periodic setările conturilor de rețele sociale — limitează cine îți vede postările și informațiile personale.",
                s4_check_title: "Checklist de securitate — primii pași siguri pe internet",
                s4_c1: "Instalez un antivirus activ și actualizat;",
                s4_c2: "Am setat parole unice și puternice pentru fiecare cont;",
                s4_c3: "Am activat autentificarea în doi pași (2FA) unde este posibil;",
                s4_c4: "Am verificat setările de confidențialitate ale rețelelor sociale;",
                s4_c5: "Știu să recunosc un e-mail de tip phishing (expeditor necunoscut, urgență falsă, greșeli de scriere);",
                s4_c6: "Nu îmi dezvălui niciodată parola — nicio firmă serioasă nu o cere;",
                s4_c7: "Am făcut o copie de rezervă a fișierelor importante.",
                s4_creator_title: "Sfat special pentru cei care vor să CREEZE pe internet",
                s4_creator_text: "Dacă vrei să publici site-uri, aplicații sau proiecte (de exemplu pe <strong>GitHub</strong>): nu include niciodată parole sau chei de acces direct în codul publicat; folosește licențe open-source corecte pentru proiectele tale și respectă licențele celorlalți; citește termenii de utilizare ai platformelor înainte de a publica; și folosește adrese de e-mail separate — una personală, una pentru înregistrări online.",
                s5_title: "Rolul în domeniul Game Design",
                s5_intro: "<strong>Game designul</strong> este unul dintre cele mai expresive domenii în care cultura tehnologiilor informaționale se manifestă. Crearea unui joc video modern combină programarea, arta digitală, psihologia și designul sonor — toate fiind posibile datorită tehnologiilor informaționale.",
                s5_g1t: "Motorare de joc",
                s5_g1p: "Engine-uri precum Unity și Unreal Engine permit crearea de lumi virtuale complexe fără a construi totul de la zero.",
                s5_g2t: "Programare",
                s5_g2p: "Limbaje precum C#, C++ și Python formează baza logică a oricărui joc interactiv.",
                s5_g3t: "Artă digitală",
                s5_g3p: "Grafica 2D/3D, animația și efectele vizuale creează experiența vizuală a jocului.",
                s5_g4t: "Design de gameplay",
                s5_g4p: "IT-ul ajută la simularea și testarea mecanicilor de joc, a dificultății și a echilibrului.",
                s5_outro: "Totodată, jocurile educative devin un instrument puternic de formare a culturii digitale: ele dezvoltă gândirea logică, rezolvarea problemelor și creativitatea. Industria gaming, care depășește ca valoare industria filmului și a muzicii la un loc, demonstrează cât de departe poate ajunge o combinație între tehnologie și creativitate.",
                s6_title: "Concluzie",
                s6_p1: "Cultura tehnologiilor informaționale nu mai este un lux, ci o necesitate a vieții moderne. Ea deschide uși spre educație de calitate, cariere de succes și participare activă în societatea digitală. Domeniul game design demonstrează perfect cum tehnologia, stăpânită la nivel cultural profund, poate transforma imaginația în realitate interactivă.",
                s6_p2: "<strong>Investind în cultura digitală, investim în viitorul nostru.</strong>",

            en: {
                panel_lang: "Language",
                panel_theme: "Theme",
                theme_toggle_aria: "Toggle theme",
                nav_despre: "About",
                nav_importanta: "Importance",
                nav_reguli: "Rules & Risks",
                nav_sfaturi: "Tips",
                nav_gamedesign: "Game Design",
                nav_concluzie: "Conclusion",
                nav_quiz: "Quiz",
                theme_light: "Theme: Light",
                theme_dark: "Theme: Dark",
                hero_title: "Information Technology Culture",
                hero_sub: "Exploring the impact of information technology on modern society and the game design industry",
                s1_title: "What is information technology culture?",
                s1_p1: "<strong>Information technology culture</strong> represents the entirety of knowledge, skills, values and practices related to the efficient and responsible use of information technology (IT) in everyday life. It includes the ability to search for, process, evaluate and transmit information using computers, the Internet and other digital devices.",
                s1_p2: "In contemporary society, also known as the <em>information society</em>, this culture has become as important as classical general culture. It forms the so-called <strong>digital competence</strong> — one of the key competences of the 21st century.",
                s2_title: "Why is it important?",
                s2_intro: "Information technology culture influences almost all spheres of modern life:",
                s2_li1: "<strong>Education</strong> — access to online learning platforms, digital resources and interactive tools;",
                s2_li2: "<strong>Work</strong> — most modern professions require basic digital skills;",
                s2_li3: "<strong>Communication</strong> — the Internet has radically changed the way we interact;",
                s2_li4: "<strong>Critical thinking</strong> — the ability to distinguish real information from disinformation;",
                s2_li5: "<strong>Security</strong> — protecting personal data and safe online browsing.",
                s2_outro: "Without a solid digital culture, a person risks being excluded from modern social, professional and educational life. That is why building this culture begins at an early age and continues throughout life.",
                s3_title: "Rules of information technology culture",
                s3_intro: "Information technology culture means not only technical skills, but also following a set of rules and behavioral norms in the digital environment (the so-called <strong>digital ethics</strong> or <strong>netiquette</strong>). Here are some of the most important rules:",
                s3_r1t: "Protect your personal data",
                s3_r1p: "Do not reveal passwords, addresses, phone numbers or banking details to unknown people or websites.",
                s3_r2t: "Respect copyright",
                s3_r2p: "Do not copy or distribute content (images, music, software, code) without proper permission or license.",
                s3_r3t: "Behave politely online",
                s3_r3p: "Do not use aggressive language, harass or humiliate other users — treat people online as you would in real life.",
                s3_r4t: "Verify the source of information",
                s3_r4p: "Before believing or sharing information, check whether it comes from a safe and credible source.",
                s3_r5t: "Use licensed software and antivirus",
                s3_r5p: "Do not install pirated programs and keep your systems updated to avoid malware.",
                s3_r6t: "Manage your screen time",
                s3_r6p: "Maintain a healthy balance between digital activities and real life.",
                s3_risk_title: "Risks of not knowing these rules",
                s3_risk_intro: "Ignoring the rules of digital culture can have serious consequences, both for the individual and for society:",
                s3_k1t: "Fraud and identity theft",
                s3_k1p: "Not knowing data protection rules, you can become a victim of identity theft, online scams (phishing) or bank account breaches.",
                s3_k2t: "Malware infection",
                s3_k2p: "Downloading pirated software or clicking on suspicious links can lead to data loss, system lockdown or cyber-espionage.",
                s3_k3t: "Disinformation and manipulation",
                s3_k3p: "Without critical thinking, a person becomes vulnerable to fake news, conspiracy theories and propaganda, contributing to their spread.",
                s3_k4t: "Cyberbullying",
                s3_k4p: "Aggressive online behavior — whether as a victim or as an aggressor — can cause serious psychological trauma, especially among young people.",
                s3_k5t: "Legal liability",
                s3_k5p: "Copyright infringement, illegal distribution of content or cybercrimes can lead to fines and even criminal liability.",
                s3_k6t: "Digital exclusion",
                s3_k6p: "The lack of basic digital skills limits access to education, jobs and modernized public services.",
                s3_warn: "<strong>Partial conclusion:</strong> Knowing and following the rules of information technology culture is the first line of defense against most dangers in the digital environment. Digital education is not optional — it is a form of self-protection.",
                s4_title: "Tips for new Internet users",
                s4_intro: "If you are just starting to browse the Internet or want to create online content, these tips will help you protect yourself and your loved ones:",
                s4_t1t: "Use strong passwords",
                s4_t1p: "Create passwords of at least 12 characters, with uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers and symbols. Do not use the same password for multiple accounts.",
                s4_t2t: "Enable two-step authentication",
                s4_t2p: "Two-factor authentication (2FA) adds an extra layer of security — even if your password is stolen, your account remains protected.",
                s4_t3t: "Beware of phishing",
                s4_t3p: "Do not click on links from suspicious emails or messages. Always verify the actual address of the website before entering data.",
                s4_t4t: "Avoid public Wi-Fi networks",
                s4_t4p: "Do not enter passwords or banking details on public Wi-Fi networks (cafes, airports) — they can be easily intercepted.",
                s4_t5t: "Make backups",
                s4_t5p: "Regularly save important files to a USB stick, external hard drive or the cloud. The 3-2-1 rule: 3 copies, on 2 media, 1 off-site.",
                s4_t6t: "Update your devices",
                s4_t6p: "System and browser updates fix security vulnerabilities. Don't postpone them!",
                s4_t7t: "Think before you post",
                s4_t7p: "Anything you post on the Internet stays there forever. Do not post information that could compromise you later.",
                s4_t8t: "Check your privacy settings",
                s4_t8p: "Regularly review your social media account settings — limit who can see your posts and personal information.",
                s4_check_title: "Security checklist — safe first steps on the Internet",
                s4_c1: "I have an active and updated antivirus installed;",
                s4_c2: "I have set unique, strong passwords for each account;",
                s4_c3: "I have enabled two-factor authentication (2FA) where possible;",
                s4_c4: "I have checked the privacy settings of my social networks;",
                s4_c5: "I know how to recognize a phishing email (unknown sender, false urgency, spelling mistakes);",
                s4_c6: "I never reveal my password — no reputable company asks for it;",
                s4_c7: "I have made a backup of important files.",
                s4_creator_title: "Special tip for those who want to CREATE on the Internet",
                s4_creator_text: "If you want to publish websites, applications or projects (for example on <strong>GitHub</strong>): never include passwords or access keys directly in published code; use proper open-source licenses for your projects and respect the licenses of others; read the platforms' terms of use before publishing; and use separate email addresses — one personal, one for online registrations.",
                s5_title: "The role in Game Design",
                s5_intro: "<strong>Game design</strong> is one of the most expressive fields in which information technology culture manifests itself. Creating a modern video game combines programming, digital art, psychology and sound design — all made possible by information technology.",
                s5_g1t: "Game engines",
                s5_g1p: "Engines such as Unity and Unreal Engine allow the creation of complex virtual worlds without building everything from scratch.",
                s5_g2t: "Programming",
                s5_g2p: "Languages such as C#, C++ and Python form the logical basis of any interactive game.",
                s5_g3t: "Digital art",
                s5_g3p: "2D/3D graphics, animation and visual effects create the game's visual experience.",
                s5_g4t: "Gameplay design",
                s5_g4p: "IT helps simulate and test game mechanics, difficulty and balance.",
                s5_outro: "At the same time, educational games become a powerful tool for building digital culture: they develop logical thinking, problem-solving and creativity. The gaming industry, which surpasses the film and music industries combined in value, demonstrates how far a combination of technology and creativity can go.",
                s6_title: "Conclusion",
                s6_p1: "Information technology culture is no longer a luxury, but a necessity of modern life. It opens doors to quality education, successful careers and active participation in the digital society. The game design field perfectly demonstrates how technology, mastered at a deep cultural level, can transform imagination into interactive reality.",
                s6_p2: "<strong>Investing in digital culture means investing in our future.</strong>",
                footer_text: "© 2025 Information Technology Culture | Published on",
                quiz_title: "Pop Quiz",
                quiz_subtitle: "Test what you've learned about information technology culture",
                quiz_score_label: "Score",
                quiz_q_meta: "Question",
                quiz_feedback_correct: "<strong>Correct!</strong> Perfect answer — keep it up!",
                quiz_feedback_wrong: "<strong>Wrong.</strong> The correct answer is marked with the green checkmark.",
                quiz_next: "Next question",
                quiz_finish: "See result",
                quiz_restart: "Restart quiz",
                quiz_results_perfect_title: "Digital expert!",
                quiz_results_perfect_msg: "Congratulations! You've mastered information technology culture at an expert level. Keep applying these skills in your everyday life.",
                quiz_results_great_title: "Well done!",
                quiz_results_great_msg: "You have solid knowledge of digital culture. A few details still need polishing — re-read the relevant sections and you'll be flawless.",
                quiz_results_ok_title: "Good start!",
                quiz_results_ok_msg: "You have a good foundation, but some important points need review. Re-read the sections about security and netiquette carefully.",
                quiz_results_low_title: "Keep learning",
                quiz_results_low_msg: "That's okay — every expert was once a beginner. Re-read the page carefully and try again. Digital culture is built step by step!",
                quiz_q1: "What does information technology culture represent?",
                quiz_q1_o1: "Only the ability to program computers",
                quiz_q1_o2: "The entirety of knowledge, skills, values and practices related to the efficient and responsible use of IT",

                quiz_q3_o1: "A type of educational video game about security",

                quiz_q4_o1: "Using the same password for all accounts",

                quiz_q4_o3: "Enabling two-step authentication (2FA)",

                panel_theme: "Тема",

                nav_importanta: "Значение",

                theme_dark: "Тема: Тёмная",
                hero_title: "Культура информационных технологий",
                hero_sub: "Изучение влияния информационных технологий на современное общество и индустрию геймдизайна",
                s1_title: "Что такое культура информационных технологий?",
                s1_p1: "<strong>Культура информационных технологий</strong> — это совокупность знаний, навыков, ценностей и практик, связанных с эффективным и ответственным использованием информационных технологий (ИТ) в повседневной жизни. Она включает способность искать, обрабатывать, оценивать и передавать информацию с помощью компьютеров, Интернета и других цифровых устройств.",
                s1_p2: "В современном обществе, известном также как <em>информационное общество</em>, эта культура стала столь же важной, как и классическая общая культура. Она формирует так называемую <strong>цифровую компетентность</strong> — одну из ключевых компетенций XXI века.",
                s2_title: "Почему это важно?",
                s2_intro: "Культура информационных технологий влияет почти на все сферы современной жизни:",
                s2_li1: "<strong>Образование</strong> — доступ к онлайн-платформам обучения, цифровым ресурсам и интерактивным инструментам;",
                s2_li2: "<strong>Работа</strong> — большинство современных профессий требуют базовых цифровых навыков;",
                s2_li3: "<strong>Общение</strong> — Интернет кардинально изменил то, как мы взаимодействуем;",
                s2_li4: "<strong>Критическое мышление</strong> — способность отличать достоверную информацию от дезинформации;",
                s2_li5: "<strong>Безопасность</strong> — защита личных данных и безопасный поиск в сети.",
                s2_outro: "Без прочной цифровой культуры человек рискует быть исключённым из современной социальной, профессиональной и образовательной жизни. Именно поэтому формирование этой культуры начинается с раннего возраста и продолжается на протяжении всей жизни.",
                s3_title: "Правила культуры информационных технологий",
                s3_intro: "Культура информационных технологий — это не только технические навыки, но и соблюдение набора правил и норм поведения в цифровой среде (так называемая <strong>цифровая этика</strong> или <strong>сетикет</strong>). Вот некоторые из самых важных правил:",
                s3_r1t: "Защищайте свои личные данные",

                quiz_q1_correct: 2,
                quiz_q2: "Что такое правило резервного копирования 3-2-1?",
                quiz_q2_o1: "3 пароля, 2 аккаунта, 1 адрес эл. почты",

                quiz_q2_o4: "3 файла, 2 папки, 1 облачный аккаунт",
                quiz_q2_correct: 2,
                quiz_q3: "Что означает «фишинг»?",
                quiz_q3_o1: "Тип обучающей видеоигры о безопасности",
                quiz_q3_o2: "Метод усиления паролей",
                quiz_q3_o3: "Онлайн-атака с целью получения личных данных путём обмана",
                quiz_q3_o4: "Современная антивирусная программа",
                quiz_q3_correct: 3,
                quiz_q4: "Что из перечисленного является БЕЗОПАСНОЙ онлайн-практикой?",

                quiz_q4_o2: "Подключение к публичному Wi-Fi для банковских операций",
                quiz_q4_o3: "Включение двухэтапной аутентификации (2FA)",
                quiz_q4_o4: "Отправка пароля по эл. почте по запросу",
                quiz_q4_correct: 3,
                quiz_q5: "Что такое «сетикет»?",
                quiz_q5_o1: "Тип компьютерной сети",
                quiz_q5_o2: "Этикетка, наклеиваемая на почтовые посылки",
                quiz_q5_o3: "Совокупность норм поведения в цифровой среде",

                quiz_q5_correct: 3
