        };

        /* ===== VALORI PERMISE (validare) ===== */
        const VALID_LANGS = Object.keys(translations);
        const VALID_THEMES = ["light", "dark"];

        /* ===== STORAGE SIGUR (funcționează și dacă localStorage e blocat) ===== */
        const storage = {
            get(key) {
                try { return localStorage.getItem(key); } catch { return null; }
            },
            set(key, value) {
                try { localStorage.setItem(key, value); } catch { /* ignoră tăcut */ }
            }
        };

        /* ===== TEMA ===== */
        function applyTheme(theme) {
            if (!VALID_THEMES.includes(theme)) theme = "light";
            document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", theme);
            updateThemeButton();
            storage.set("siteTheme", theme);
        }

        function toggleTheme() {
            const current = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme") || "light";
            applyTheme(current === "light" ? "dark" : "light");
        }

        function updateThemeButton() {
            const theme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme") || "light";
            const lang = document.documentElement.lang || "ro";
            const t = translations[lang];
            if (!t) return;
            const btn = document.getElementById("themeToggle");
            if (btn) {
                btn.textContent = theme === "light" ? t.theme_light : t.theme_dark;
                btn.setAttribute("aria-label", t.theme_toggle_aria);
            }
        }

        /* ===== LIMBA ===== */
        function setLanguage(lang) {
            if (!VALID_LANGS.includes(lang)) lang = "ro";
            const t = translations[lang];
            document.documentElement.lang = lang;
            document.title = t.hero_title;
            document.querySelectorAll("[data-i18n]").forEach(el => {
                const key = el.getAttribute("data-i18n");
                if (t[key] !== undefined) {
                    el.innerHTML = t[key];
                }
            });
            document.querySelectorAll(".lang-switcher button").forEach(btn => {
                btn.classList.toggle("active", btn.getAttribute("data-lang") === lang);
            });
            updateThemeButton();
            storage.set("siteLang", lang);
            // Re-aplică word-reveal pe titlul hero (textul s-a schimbat)
            if (typeof window.applyWordReveal === "function") window.applyWordReveal();
            // Re-randează quiz-ul în noua limbă (dacă a fost inițializat)
            if (typeof renderQuiz === "function") renderQuiz();
        }

        document.querySelectorAll(".lang-switcher button").forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener("click", () => setLanguage(btn.getAttribute("data-lang")));
        });

        document.getElementById("themeToggle").addEventListener("click", toggleTheme);

        /* ===== ÎNCĂRCAREA PREFERINȚELOR SALVATE (cu validare) ===== */
        const savedLang = storage.get("siteLang");
        const savedTheme = storage.get("siteTheme");
        applyTheme(VALID_THEMES.includes(savedTheme) ? savedTheme : "light");
        setLanguage(VALID_LANGS.includes(savedLang) ? savedLang : "ro");
    
        /* ===== PARALLAX SCROLL FOR BACKGROUND PARTICLES ===== */
        (function () {
            // Skip on reduced-motion preference
            if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
                return;
            }

            const layers = document.querySelectorAll('.particle-layer');
            if (!layers.length) return;

            // Different speeds for different layers
            // Slow layer = far away (barely moves on scroll)
            // Fast layer = closer to viewer (moves more)
            const speeds = [
                { y: 0.35, x: 0.08, m: 0.6 },   // layer-slow — moves a bit
                { y: 0.85, x: 0.18, m: 1.2 },   // layer-medium — moves more
                { y: 1.45, x: 0.30, m: 2.0 }    // layer-fast — moves a lot (foreground)
            ];

            // Wrap each layer's children inside an inner div so we can apply
            // scroll parallax transform WITHOUT overriding the parent's CSS
            // keyframe drift animation.
            layers.forEach(layer => {
                const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
                wrapper.className = 'parallax-inner';
                wrapper.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;will-change:transform;transform:translate3d(0,0,0);';
                while (layer.firstChild) {
                    wrapper.appendChild(layer.firstChild);
                }
                layer.appendChild(wrapper);
            });

            const innerWrappers = document.querySelectorAll('.parallax-inner');
            let scrollY = window.scrollY || window.pageYOffset;
            let mouseX = 0, mouseY = 0;
            let ticking = false;

            function applyParallax() {
                ticking = false;
                for (let i = 0; i < innerWrappers.length; i++) {
                    const cfg = speeds[i] || { y: 0.5, x: 0, m: 1 };
                    // Scroll parallax: layers move opposite to scroll direction
                    // for depth illusion. Negative = moves up when scrolling down.
                    // Bigger multiplier = more visible movement per scroll px.
                    const tx = -scrollY * cfg.x * 1.0 + mouseX * 24 * cfg.m;
                    const ty = -scrollY * cfg.y * 0.55 + mouseY * 18 * cfg.m;
                    innerWrappers[i].style.transform = `translate3d(${tx.toFixed(2)}px, ${ty.toFixed(2)}px, 0)`;
                }
            }

            function onScroll() {
                scrollY = window.scrollY || window.pageYOffset;
                if (!ticking) {
                    window.requestAnimationFrame(applyParallax);
                    ticking = true;
                }
            }

            function onMouseMove(e) {
                mouseX = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth - 0.5) * 2;
                mouseY = (e.clientY / window.innerHeight - 0.5) * 2;
                if (!ticking) {
                    window.requestAnimationFrame(applyParallax);
                    ticking = true;
                }
            }

            window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
            document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove, { passive: true });

            // Initial paint
            applyParallax();
        })();

        /* ===== POP QUIZ ===== */
        (function () {
            const QUIZ_COUNT = 5; // numărul de întrebări (quiz_q1 … quiz_q5)

            const cardEl = document.getElementById("quizCard");
            const resultsEl = document.getElementById("quizResults");
            const scoreEl = document.getElementById("quizScore");
            const totalEl = document.getElementById("quizTotal");
            const progressBarEl = document.getElementById("quizProgressBar");
            const finalScoreEl = document.getElementById("quizFinalScore");
            const finalTotalEl = document.getElementById("quizFinalTotal");
            const resultsTitleEl = document.getElementById("quizResultsTitle");
            const resultsMsgEl = document.getElementById("quizResultsMsg");
            const restartBtn = document.getElementById("quizRestartBtn");

            if (!cardEl || !resultsEl || !restartBtn) return;

            // Starea curentă a quiz-ului (memo per sesiune, fără localStorage)
            let currentIdx = 0;       // 0-based index al întrebării curente
            let score = 0;            // număr de răspunsuri corecte
            let answered = false;     // s-a răspuns deja la întrebarea curentă?
            let selectedIdx = -1;     // indexul variantei selectate (0-based)

            function getLang() {
                return document.documentElement.lang || "ro";
            }

            function t(key) {
                const lang = getLang();
                const dict = translations[lang] || translations.ro;
                return dict[key] !== undefined ? dict[key] : (translations.ro[key] || key);
            }

            function buildQuestionData(idx) {
                const lang = getLang();
                const dict = translations[lang] || translations.ro;
                const n = idx + 1; // 1-based
                const qText = dict["quiz_q" + n];
                const correct = dict["quiz_q" + n + "_correct"]; // 1-based
                const options = [];
                for (let i = 1; i <= 4; i++) {
                    options.push(dict["quiz_q" + n + "_o" + i]);
                }
                return { text: qText, options: options, correct: correct };
            }

            function letterFor(i) {
                return ["A", "B", "C", "D"][i] || String.fromCharCode(65 + i);
            }

            const ICON_CHECK = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/></svg>';
            const ICON_X = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"/><line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"/></svg>';
            const ICON_FEEDBACK_OK = '<svg class="quiz__feedback-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#2ecc71" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><polyline points="9 12 11 14 15 9"/></svg>';
            const ICON_FEEDBACK_BAD = '<svg class="quiz__feedback-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#ff4d6d" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><line x1="15" y1="9" x2="9" y2="15"/><line x1="9" y1="9" x2="15" y2="15"/></svg>';

            function updateScoreUI() {
                scoreEl.textContent = score;
                totalEl.textContent = QUIZ_COUNT;
                finalTotalEl.textContent = QUIZ_COUNT;
                const pct = (currentIdx / QUIZ_COUNT) * 100;
                progressBarEl.style.width = pct + "%";
            }

            function renderQuiz() {
                // Dacă am ajuns la final, afișăm rezultatele
                if (currentIdx >= QUIZ_COUNT) {
                    showResults();
                    return;
                }

                // Ascundem rezultatele și afișăm cardul întrebării
                resultsEl.hidden = true;
                cardEl.style.display = "";

                const data = buildQuestionData(currentIdx);
                answered = false;
                selectedIdx = -1;

                // Re-pornim animația de intrare
                cardEl.classList.remove("quiz__card-anim");
                void cardEl.offsetWidth; // forțăm reflow
                cardEl.style.animation = "none";
                void cardEl.offsetWidth;
                cardEl.style.animation = "";

                const metaText = t("quiz_q_meta") + " " + (currentIdx + 1) + " / " + QUIZ_COUNT;
                const nextLabel = (currentIdx + 1 < QUIZ_COUNT) ? t("quiz_next") : t("quiz_finish");

                const optionsHTML = data.options.map((opt, i) => {
                    return `
                        <li>
                            <button type="button"
                                    class="quiz__option"
                                    data-idx="${i}"
                                    aria-label="${letterFor(i)}: ${opt.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "")}">
                                <span class="quiz__marker" aria-hidden="true">${letterFor(i)}</span>
                                <span class="quiz__option-text">${opt}</span>
                            </button>
                        </li>`;
                }).join("");

                cardEl.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="quiz__q-meta">
                        <span class="quiz__q-index">${metaText}</span>
                    </div>
                    <p class="quiz__q-text">${data.text}</p>
                    <ul class="quiz__options" role="list">${optionsHTML}</ul>
                    <div class="quiz__feedback" id="quizFeedback" hidden></div>
                    <div class="quiz__actions">
                        <button type="button" class="quiz__btn quiz__btn--ghost" id="quizSkipReset">
                            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><polyline points="1 4 1 10 7 10"/><path d="M3.51 15a9 9 0 1 0 2.13-9.36L1 10"/></svg>
                            <span data-i18n="quiz_restart">${t("quiz_restart")}</span>
                        </button>
                        <button type="button" class="quiz__btn quiz__btn--primary" id="quizNextBtn" disabled>
                            <span id="quizNextLabel">${nextLabel}</span>
                            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/><polyline points="12 5 19 12 12 19"/></svg>
                        </button>
                    </div>
                `;

                // Bind pentru opțiuni
                cardEl.querySelectorAll(".quiz__option").forEach(btn => {
                    btn.addEventListener("click", onOptionClick);
                });

                // Bind pentru butonul Următorul
                const nextBtn = document.getElementById("quizNextBtn");
                if (nextBtn) {
                    nextBtn.addEventListener("click", onNextClick);
                }

                // Bind pentru restart
                const skipReset = document.getElementById("quizSkipReset");
                if (skipReset) {
                    skipReset.addEventListener("click", resetQuiz);
                }

                updateScoreUI();
            }

            function onOptionClick(e) {
                if (answered) return;
                const btn = e.currentTarget;
                const idx = parseInt(btn.getAttribute("data-idx"), 10); // 0-based
                selectedIdx = idx;
                answered = true;

                const data = buildQuestionData(currentIdx);
                const correctIdx = data.correct - 1; // convertim la 0-based
                const isCorrect = (idx === correctIdx);

                // Marcăm toate opțiunile
                const allOptions = cardEl.querySelectorAll(".quiz__option");
                allOptions.forEach((opt, i) => {
                    opt.disabled = true;
                    const marker = opt.querySelector(".quiz__marker");
                    if (i === correctIdx) {
                        opt.classList.add("quiz__option--correct");
                        if (marker) marker.innerHTML = ICON_CHECK;
                    } else if (i === idx) {
                        // Răspuns greșit selectat
                        opt.classList.add("quiz__option--wrong");
                        if (marker) marker.innerHTML = ICON_X;
                    } else {
                        // Celelalte se estompează ușor
                        opt.classList.add("quiz__option--muted");
                    }
                });

                // Actualizăm scorul
                if (isCorrect) {
                    score++;
                    updateScoreUI();
                }

                // Afișăm feedback-ul
                const fb = document.getElementById("quizFeedback");
                if (fb) {
                    fb.hidden = false;
                    fb.className = "quiz__feedback " + (isCorrect ? "quiz__feedback--correct" : "quiz__feedback--wrong");
                    fb.innerHTML = (isCorrect ? ICON_FEEDBACK_OK : ICON_FEEDBACK_BAD) +
                                   '<span class="quiz__feedback-text">' + (isCorrect ? t("quiz_feedback_correct") : t("quiz_feedback_wrong")) + '</span>';
                }

                // Activăm butonul Următorul
                const nextBtn = document.getElementById("quizNextBtn");
                if (nextBtn) nextBtn.disabled = false;
            }

            function onNextClick() {
                if (!answered) return;
                currentIdx++;
                renderQuiz();
            }

            function showResults() {
                cardEl.style.display = "none";
                resultsEl.hidden = false;
                finalScoreEl.textContent = score;

                const pct = score / QUIZ_COUNT;
                let titleKey, msgKey;
                if (pct === 1) {
                    titleKey = "quiz_results_perfect_title";
                    msgKey = "quiz_results_perfect_msg";
                } else if (pct >= 0.6) {
                    titleKey = "quiz_results_great_title";
                    msgKey = "quiz_results_great_msg";
                } else if (pct >= 0.4) {
                    titleKey = "quiz_results_ok_title";
                    msgKey = "quiz_results_ok_msg";
                } else {
                    titleKey = "quiz_results_low_title";
                    msgKey = "quiz_results_low_msg";
                }
                resultsTitleEl.textContent = t(titleKey);
                resultsMsgEl.textContent = t(msgKey);

                // Bara de progres la 100%
                progressBarEl.style.width = "100%";
            }

            function resetQuiz() {
                currentIdx = 0;
                score = 0;
                answered = false;
                selectedIdx = -1;
                renderQuiz();
            }

            restartBtn.addEventListener("click", resetQuiz);

            // Inițializare la încărcare
            // (apelăm după ce DOM-ul e complet și limba a fost aplicată)
            updateScoreUI();
            renderQuiz();
        })();

        /* ===== SCROLL REVEAL ANIMATIONS ===== */
        /* Inspirat din Apple, Stripe, Linear — animații subtile la intrarea în viewport.
           Folosește IntersectionObserver (performant, fără a bloca scroll-ul). */
        (function () {
            const prefersReduced = window.matchMedia &&
                window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

            // Selectoare pentru elementele care vor fi animate
            const REVEAL_SELECTORS = [
                'header p',
                'section > .card > h2',
                'section > .card > p',
                'section > .card > ul.styled',
                'section > .card > .grid',
                '.rule-box',
                '.risk-item',
                '.tip-card',
                '.grid-item',
                '.security-checklist',
                '.creator-tip',
                '.warn-banner',
                '.conclusion',
                '.quiz',
                'footer p'
            ];

            // Aplică automat atributul data-reveal cu varianta potrivită
            document.querySelectorAll(REVEAL_SELECTORS.join(', ')).forEach(el => {
                if (el.hasAttribute('data-reveal')) return;
                if (el.matches('.rule-box, .risk-item, .tip-card, .grid-item, .security-checklist, .creator-tip, .conclusion, .quiz')) {
                    el.setAttribute('data-reveal', 'scale');
                } else if (el.matches('.warn-banner')) {
                    el.setAttribute('data-reveal', 'fade-right');
                } else {
                    el.setAttribute('data-reveal', 'fade-up');
                }
            });

            /* ===== Word-by-word reveal pentru titlul hero (efect Apple keynote) ===== */
            function applyWordReveal() {
                const targets = document.querySelectorAll('header h1');
                targets.forEach(el => {
                    const text = el.textContent.trim();
                    if (!text) return;
                    const words = text.split(/\s+/);
                    el.innerHTML = words.map((w, i) =>
                        '<span class="word" style="transition-delay:' + (i * 70) + 'ms">' + w + '</span>'
                    ).join(' ');
                    el.setAttribute('data-word-reveal', '');
                });
            }
            applyWordReveal();
            // Expunem funcția global pentru a fi reapelată la schimbarea limbii
            window.applyWordReveal = applyWordReveal;

            /* ===== Stagger pentru copiii containerelor grupate ===== */
            function applyStagger() {
                // Grile și liste
                const groupSelectors = [
                    '.risk-grid',
                    '.tip-grid',
                    'section > .card > .grid',
                    'ul.styled',
                    '.security-checklist ul'
                ];
                groupSelectors.forEach(sel => {
                    document.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach(group => {
                        const items = Array.from(group.children).filter(c => c.hasAttribute('data-reveal'));
                        items.forEach((item, i) => {
                            item.style.setProperty('--reveal-delay', (i * 90) + 'ms');
                        });
                    });
                });

                // Rule-boxes consecutive (în secțiunea #reguli)
                const ruleContainer = document.querySelector('section#reguli .card');
                if (ruleContainer) {
                    let count = 0;
                    Array.from(ruleContainer.children).forEach(child => {
                        if (child.classList.contains('rule-box')) {
                            child.style.setProperty('--reveal-delay', (count * 80) + 'ms');
                            count++;
                        }
                    });
                }

                // Paragrafe & heading-uri consecutive în card/conclusion
                document.querySelectorAll('.card, .conclusion').forEach(group => {
                    let count = 0;
                    Array.from(group.children).forEach(child => {
                        if (child.hasAttribute('data-reveal') && !child.hasAttribute('data-word-reveal')) {
                            // Nu suprascriem delay-ul deja setat pentru elemente de tip grid
                            if (!child.matches('.rule-box, .risk-item, .tip-card, .grid-item')) {
                                child.style.setProperty('--reveal-delay', (count * 80) + 'ms');
                            }
                            count++;
                        }
                    });
                });
            }
            applyStagger();

            // Respectă preferința de motion redus — toate elementele devin vizibile instant
            if (prefersReduced) {
                document.querySelectorAll('[data-reveal], [data-word-reveal]').forEach(el => {
                    el.classList.add('is-visible');
                });
                return;
            }

            /* ===== IntersectionObserver pentru declanșarea animațiilor ===== */
            const observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
                entries.forEach(function (entry) {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');
                    } else {
                        // Permite re-animarea la scroll înapoi (jos SAU sus)
                        entry.target.classList.remove('is-visible');
                    }
                });
            }, {
                threshold: 0.12,           // declanșează când 12% din element e vizibil
                rootMargin: '0px 0px -8% 0px' // ușor mai devreme decât intrarea completă
            });

            document.querySelectorAll('[data-reveal], [data-word-reveal]').forEach(el => {
                observer.observe(el);
            });
        })();

</script>

</body>
</html>
